title: marineSim: spatio-temporal random forests for marine species distribution modelling under data limitation
description:
Simulation benchmark, R package (marineSim) and applied analysis code for the spatio-temporal random forest (stRF) method. stRF augments an ordinary random forest with coordinates, Euclidean distance fields, multi scale spatial lags and temporal features built from the training sites alone.

The repository contains: the R simulation engine and the expanded benchmark (six ground truth worlds × six field realisations × three sampling designs × five sample sizes × four timestep spans, with detection and Poisson abundance extensions; 3,779 datasets and an exact Shapley decomposition over feature block coalitions); GAM and sdmTMB comparators; the Posidonia sinuosa seagrass case study for five Western Australian marine parks; and all code and stored results needed to regenerate every figure, table and number reported in the associated article.

Version 1.0.0 accompanies the article submitted to Methods in Ecology and Evolution.
